title: LK-99 room-temperature superconductor papers

tellings.quote: Do you know that that team was so sure of their results that they published one paper with six authors and then they published another paper with three authors because only three people can share a Nobel Prize. They were that confident.

plain: In 2023 a team in South Korea published papers on LK-99, a material they said could carry electricity with no resistance at room temperature, and according to Michels they were so sure of it that they put out one paper with six authors and another with only three, because no more than three people can share a Nobel Prize. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as a story of how confident the team was.
